## Ash (Asheron Fenwick), level 1
**Human Rogue 1 · Wayfarer background · age 20 · the youngest brother**
*Subclass at level 3: Thief-Swashbuckler (house rule; see the rules file).*

| STR | DEX | CON | INT | WIS | CHA |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 13 (+1) | **18 (+4)** | 14 (+2) | 13 (+1) | 14 (+2) | **18 (+4)** |

- **Armor Class:** 15 (leather armor 11 + Dex 4)
- **Hit Points:** 10 (hit die d8; +7 per level after 1st, or roll d8+2)
- **Initiative:** +4 · **Speed:** 30 ft · **Size:** Medium
- **Proficiency bonus:** +2
- **Saving throws:** **Dex +6**, **Int +3** (proficient) · Str +1 · Con +2 · Wis +2 · Cha +4
- **Skills:** **Stealth +8** (expertise) · **Perception +6** (expertise) · Sleight of Hand +6 · Deception +6 · Acrobatics +6 · Persuasion +6 · Insight +4. Untrained: Athletics +1, Investigation +1, Intimidation +4, others at the score's modifier.
- **Passive Perception:** 16 · **Passive Insight:** 14
- **Tools:** Thieves' Tools +6 · Playing Cards +6 (proficient). He also owns dice and a shell-game set (cups and ball) without proficiency. The shell game uses Sleight of Hand.
- **Languages:** Common, Thieves' Cant, Dwarvish, Halfling

**Attacks**
| Weapon | To hit | Damage | Mastery / notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Shortsword | +6 | 1d6+4 piercing | **Vex:** on a hit, advantage on your next attack against that creature before the end of your next turn. Light, finesse. |
| Dagger (off hand) | +6 | 1d4 piercing (no modifier on the extra off-hand attack) | **Nick:** the extra Light-weapon attack happens as part of the Attack action, not as a bonus action. |
| Dagger (thrown) | +6 | 1d4+4 piercing | Range 20/60 |
| Shortbow | +6 | 1d6+4 piercing | Range 80/320. No mastery. |

**Typical turn:** Attack with the shortsword, then the off-hand dagger as part of the same action (Nick). His **bonus action** stays free, for Cunning Action from level 2.

**Rogue features**
- **Sneak Attack (1d6):** once per turn, +1d6 to one hit with a finesse or ranged weapon if you have advantage, **or** if an ally of yours is within 5 feet of the target (and you don't have disadvantage).
- **Expertise:** Stealth, Perception. (Two more at level 6.)
- **Thieves' Cant:** the secret signs and slang of thieves.
- **Weapon Mastery:** Shortsword (Vex), Dagger (Nick).

**Feats**
- **Lucky** (Wayfarer): **2 Luck Points** per long rest (equal to proficiency bonus). Spend one for advantage on your own d20 test, decided after the roll, or to give disadvantage to an attack against you.
- **Magic Initiate (Wizard)** (human Versatile): spellcasting ability **Charisma**. **Spell save DC 12 · spell attack +6.**
  - Cantrips: **Message**, **Prestidigitation**
  - 1st level: **Find Familiar**, free once per long rest (still needs 10 gp of incense), or as a ritual

**Human traits:** Resourceful (Heroic Inspiration after every long rest) · Skillful (Persuasion) · Versatile (Magic Initiate)

**Familiar: Bartholomew ("Bart"), owl**
- AC 11 · HP 1 · Speed 5 ft, fly 60 ft · darkvision 120 ft · Perception +5, Stealth +5
- **Flyby:** no opportunity attacks when he flies out of reach
- Telepathic to Ash only, within 100 feet. Uses **Help** to give Ash advantage.
- Celestial spirit. Free shape-swap once a day out of combat (house rule); he picks the shape.
- Personality: snarky, mocks the brothers, lippy with Ash.

**Gear**
- **Armor and weapons:** leather armor · shortsword · 4 daggers · shortbow, quiver, 20 arrows
- **Tools:** thieves' tools
- **Burglar's pack:** backpack, ball bearings, bell, 10 candles, crowbar, hooded lantern, 7 flasks of oil, 5 days of rations, 50 ft of rope, tinderbox, waterskin
- **Clothes and bedding:** bedroll · traveler's clothes · fine clothes · 2 pouches
- **Games:** playing cards · dice · shell-game cups and ball
- **Bought:** manacles · grappling hook · caltrops (bag) · steel mirror · chalk · 10 pitons
- **Keepsake:** a dented pewter half-locket on a leather cord under his shirt. On the front is a worn crest: a river ford with antlers above it. Inside, behind cracked glass, is a curl of baby hair and a scratched "A." The hinge is broken off on one side. Gideon gave it to him when he was ten: "That was Mum's. That's your hair in it. The other half was lost in the fire." Ash has pawned everything he owns at least once. He's never pawned this, and he's never quite been able to say why.
- **Coin:** 10 gp

**Coming up (Rogue):** L2 Cunning Action (Dash, Disengage or Hide as a bonus action) · L3 subclass + Steady Aim · L4 feat · L5 Cunning Strike, Uncanny Dodge · L6 Expertise ×2 · L7 Evasion, Reliable Talent · L8 feat · L9 Panache · L10 feat · L11 Improved Cunning Strike · L12 feat · L13 Use Magic Device · L14 Devious Strikes · L15 Slippery Mind · L16 feat · L17 Thief's Reflexes · L18 Elusive · L19 Epic Boon · L20 Stroke of Luck. Sneak Attack grows by 1d6 every odd level, to 10d6 at L19.

**Feat proposals (Ash's player confirms each one at level-up; these are suggestions only):**
| Level | Proposal | Why |
|---|---|---|
| 4 | **Ability Score Improvement:** Dex 18 → 20 | Every attack, AC, Stealth and initiative go up |
| 8 | **Alert** | You traded it away at level 1. Here it comes back: +3 initiative and Initiative Swap. |
| 10 | **Ability Score Improvement:** Cha 18 → 20 | Panache, Persuasion, Deception, spell DC |
| 12 | **Resilient (Wisdom)**, Wis 15 | Proficiency in Wisdom saves. Mind-affecting magic gets nastier at high levels. |
| 16 | **Tavern Brawler**, or **Tough** | The fight rings, or simply staying alive |
| 19 | **Boon of Combat Prowess** | Once per turn, a miss can become a hit, which nearly guarantees Sneak Attack |
